change: Keep the English research challenger coefficients. Enrich Arabic human development with native pre-2019 Wikipedia prose taken from the original (not translated) ARCD corpus. Keep AIRABIC and split additional passages by original article title.
threshold: 99.8th percentile using the higher order statistic of per-document maximum human validation-window logits
new_primary_test: Ar-APT independent 400 original human press articles and 400 fully machine-generated articles in eight subject domains. Use original article fields separately from their polish variants. Report raw, removed, abstaining and analyzed counts.
additional_external: Separate human academic abstracts from KFUPM and Claude-polished counterparts. Treat polished human writing as assisted, not as a known wholly machine-authored passage.
arabic_release_gate: Less than 1% any false signal among both eligible Ar-APT human articles and KFUPM human abstracts, plus at least 50% recall on Ar-APT fully generated articles. Retain already seen o-qn collection as regression information, not a fresh blind test.
bilingual_release_gate: Also meet the previously fixed English release gates for AIP-HL-2. No production promotion on a partial pass.
